decision.reason: [ev-76a46c52508c] only describes who is unaffected: anyone who never set `-boltdb.shipper.shared-store.key-prefix`, `-tsdb.shipper.shared-store.key-prefix` or the matching YAML setting. Its section heading says `shared_store_key_prefix` was removed. The excerpt does not say what replaced the setting, what happens to a deployment that did set it (for example, whether the config is rejected or the setting is ignored), or what migration is needed. It also covers two flags plus an unnamed YAML key. To write the change and consequence, we need the other bullets in the same upgrade-guide section that describe the configured case.
